announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The general meeting results follow the October fundraise updates. Shareholders should monitor the November timetable for next steps.

announcements.headline: Fundraise Update
announcements.insight: The fundraise update follows the October placing and retail offer. Shareholders should watch for the circular publication and GM notice scheduled for November.

announcements.headline: Publication of Circular and Notice of GM
announcements.insight: Following the October capital raise, this GM notice signals a critical next step in the funding process. Shareholders should watch for the outcome of this meeting.

announcements.headline: Result of Retail Offer & Update to Timetable
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group confirms retail offer results following the October placing. Shareholders should monitor the updated timetable for completion.

announcements.headline: Retail Offer to raise up to £0.25 million
announcements.insight: A retail offer follows the earlier placing results. Shareholders should monitor the final capital raised.

announcements.headline: Results of Placing
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group announces results of a placing. This follows earlier announcements regarding Raw Cut earn-outs and new business developments.

announcements.headline: Zinc Wins $6.1m Feature Film Commission
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group secures a $6.1m feature film commission, adding to its production pipeline alongside the recent WHAM! documentary and Cicada AI label launch.

announcements.headline: Launch of Cicada - Zinc Media Group's AI label
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group launches Cicada, an AI label. This follows recent distribution deals and documentary production, indicating continued operational expansion.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for material changes in shareholding that might signal insider sentiment.

announcements.headline: Replacement: Payment of Raw Cut earn-out
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group pays a final earn-out for Raw Cut, following the June 30 payment. This settles prior obligations linked to the WHAM! documentary.

announcements.headline: Payment of final Raw Cut earn-out
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group pays a final Raw Cut earn-out. This follows the June announcement of the WHAM! documentary produced by Zinc Media.

announcements.headline: WHAM! documentary produced by Zinc Media
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group has produced a documentary. This follows international sales secured in June, indicating ongoing commercial activity.

announcements.headline: Zinc Distribution secures international sales
announcements.insight: Zinc Distribution secures international sales. This follows a new £3m Revolving Credit Facility in June and the AGM result.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. This follows the June 2026 credit facility announcement.

announcements.headline: New £3m Revolving Credit Facility
announcements.insight: Zinc Media Group has secured a new £3m revolving credit facility. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on how this debt is utilized.
